Offline transcription, voice activity, text to speech and subtitles. 9 tools. Run any of them from the app, as `dogubako speech <tool>`, over the [HTTP API](/reference/http-api/) or as an [MCP tool](/agents/overview/).

| Tool | Id | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| [Convert Transcript / Subtitles](#convert-transcript--subtitles) | `speech.transcript_convert` | — |
| [Shift Subtitle Timing](#shift-subtitle-timing) | `speech.subtitle_shift` | — |
| [Transcribe Audio / Video](#transcribe-audio--video) | `speech.transcribe` | whisper.cpp, FFmpeg, FFprobe, a Whisper speech model |
| [Detect Spoken Language](#detect-spoken-language) | `speech.detect_language` | whisper.cpp, FFmpeg, FFprobe, a Whisper speech model |
| [Generate Subtitles](#generate-subtitles) | `speech.subtitles` | whisper.cpp, FFmpeg, FFprobe, a Whisper speech model |
| [Text to Speech](#text-to-speech) | `speech.tts` | Piper TTS, a Piper voice |
| [Voice Activity Detection](#voice-activity-detection) | `speech.vad` | FFmpeg, FFprobe |
| [Extract Speech Segments](#extract-speech-segments) | `speech.extract_segments` | FFmpeg, FFprobe |
| [Split at Pauses](#split-at-pauses) | `speech.split_by_speech` | FFmpeg, FFprobe |

## Convert Transcript / Subtitles

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Convert transcripts and subtitles between SRT, WebVTT, JSON segments, plain text and Markdown.

```sh
dogubako speech transcript-convert [text] [options]
```

Id `speech.transcript_convert` · MCP `speech_transcript_convert` · Output: text (`text/plain`) · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: srt to vtt, vtt to srt, subtitles, captions, transcript, json, convert subtitles

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | positional | text (multi-line) |  | Paste SRT, WebVTT, JSON segments or plain text. |
| `file` | `--file` | file |  | …or choose a file. Accepts .srt .vtt .json .txt. |
| `input_format` | `--input-format` | choice | `auto` | One of: `auto` (Auto-detect), `srt`, `vtt` (WebVTT), `json` (JSON segments / whisper.cpp JSON), `txt` (Plain text). *Advanced.* |
| `output_format` | `--output-format` | choice | `vtt` | One of: `vtt` (WebVTT), `srt`, `json` (JSON segments), `txt` (Plain text), `md` (Markdown). |

## Shift Subtitle Timing

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Fix out-of-sync subtitles: shift SRT/WebVTT cues by an offset, stretch them by a factor or frame-rate ratio, optionally from a given time on.

```sh
dogubako speech subtitle-shift [text] [options]
```

Id `speech.subtitle_shift` · MCP `speech_subtitle_shift` · Output: text (`text/plain`) · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: sync subtitles, delay, offset, subtitle timing, resync, framerate, srt

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | positional | text (multi-line) |  | Paste SRT, WebVTT, JSON segments or plain text. |
| `file` | `--file` | file |  | …or choose a file. Accepts .srt .vtt .json .txt. |
| `input_format` | `--input-format` | choice | `auto` | One of: `auto` (Auto-detect), `srt`, `vtt` (WebVTT), `json` (JSON segments / whisper.cpp JSON), `txt` (Plain text). *Advanced.* |
| `offset` | `--offset` | number -86400–86400 | `0` | Offset (seconds, negative = earlier). |
| `factor` | `--factor` | number 0.1–10 | `1` | Multiply all times (e.g. 1.001 or 25/23.976). *Advanced.* |
| `fps_from` | `--fps-from` | number 1–240 |  | Sets the factor to fps\_from / fps\_to. *Advanced.* |
| `fps_to` | `--fps-to` | number 1–240 |  | …to frame rate. *Advanced.* |
| `from_time` | `--from-time` | text |  | Only shift cues starting at or after this time. *Advanced.* |
| `output_format` | `--output-format` | choice | `same` | One of: `same` (Same as input), `srt`, `vtt` (WebVTT). |

## Transcribe Audio / Video

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-model">local model</span><span>whisper.cpp</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>model: whisper</span><span>progress</span></div>

Offline speech-to-text with whisper.cpp: transcribe or translate audio and video to text, SRT, WebVTT, JSON or Markdown, with optional word timestamps, speaker turns and VAD.

```sh
dogubako speech transcribe <files…> [options]
```

Id `speech.transcribe` · MCP `speech_transcribe` · Output: text (`text/plain`) · Timeout 360 min

Also found by: speech to text, whisper, transcription, dictation, captions, subtitles, stt, asr, meeting notes, interview

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Audio / video. Accepts audio/\*, video/\*, .mp3 .m4a .aac .wav .flac .ogg +24 more. |
| `formats` | `--formats` | list of choices | `txt,srt` | Any of: `txt` (Text), `srt`, `vtt` (WebVTT), `json`, `md` (Markdown). |
| `model` | `--model` | choice | `auto` | Whisper model (download models in Settings → Models). One of: `auto` (Best installed), `whisper-tiny` (Whisper tiny), `whisper-tiny.en` (Whisper tiny (English)), `whisper-base` (Whisper base), `whisper-base.en` (Whisper base (English)), `whisper-small` (Whisper small), `whisper-small.en` (Whisper small (English)), `whisper-small.en-tdrz` (Whisper small + tinydiarize), `whisper-large-v3-turbo-q5_0` (Whisper large-v3 turbo (q5)), `whisper-large-v3-turbo` (Whisper large-v3 turbo). |
| `language` | `--language` | text | `auto` | Spoken language code, or 'auto' to detect. |
| `translate` | `--translate` | boolean | `false` | Translate the speech to English. |
| `vad` | `--vad` | boolean | `false` | Skip non-speech with Silero VAD (needs the 'silero-vad' model). *Advanced.* |
| `prompt` | `--prompt` | text (multi-line) |  | Initial prompt: names, spelling or style hints. *Advanced.* |
| `threads` | `--threads` | integer 1–64 | `4` | *Advanced.* |
| `word_timestamps` | `--word-timestamps` | boolean | `false` | Include per-word timings in the JSON / data. *Advanced.* |
| `diarize` | `--diarize` | choice | `none` | One of: `none` (Off), `tinydiarize` (Speaker turns (tinydiarize model)), `stereo` (Stereo: one speaker per channel). *Advanced.* |

## Generate Subtitles

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-model">local model</span><span>whisper.cpp</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>model: whisper</span><span>progress</span></div>

Automatically create SRT/WebVTT subtitles from speech with whisper.cpp, optionally adding them to the video as a soft track or burning them in.

```sh
dogubako speech subtitles <files…> [options]
```

Id `speech.subtitles` · MCP `speech_subtitles` · Output: files · Timeout 360 min

Also found by: auto subtitles, captions, closed captions, srt, vtt, whisper, accessibility, auto caption

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Video / audio. Accepts audio/\*, video/\*, .mp3 .m4a .aac .wav .flac .ogg +24 more. |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `srt` | One of: `srt`, `vtt` (WebVTT), `both` (SRT + WebVTT). |
| `max_chars` | `--max-chars` | integer 0–200 | `42` | 0 = whisper's natural segments. |
| `embed` | `--embed` | choice | `none` | One of: `none` (Subtitle file only), `soft` (Add to video as a track), `burn` (Burn into the video). |
| `model` | `--model` | choice | `auto` | Whisper model (download models in Settings → Models). One of: `auto` (Best installed), `whisper-tiny` (Whisper tiny), `whisper-tiny.en` (Whisper tiny (English)), `whisper-base` (Whisper base), `whisper-base.en` (Whisper base (English)), `whisper-small` (Whisper small), `whisper-small.en` (Whisper small (English)), `whisper-small.en-tdrz` (Whisper small + tinydiarize), `whisper-large-v3-turbo-q5_0` (Whisper large-v3 turbo (q5)), `whisper-large-v3-turbo` (Whisper large-v3 turbo). |
| `language` | `--language` | text | `auto` | Spoken language code, or 'auto' to detect. |
| `translate` | `--translate` | boolean | `false` | Translate the speech to English. |
| `vad` | `--vad` | boolean | `false` | Skip non-speech with Silero VAD (needs the 'silero-vad' model). *Advanced.* |
| `prompt` | `--prompt` | text (multi-line) |  | Initial prompt: names, spelling or style hints. *Advanced.* |
| `threads` | `--threads` | integer 1–64 | `4` | *Advanced.* |
| `font_size` | `--font-size` | integer 0–200 | `0` | 0 = automatic. Only used when `embed` is `burn`. |
| `color` | `--color` | color | `#ffffff` | Only used when `embed` is `burn`. |
| `outline_color` | `--outline-color` | color | `#000000` | Only used when `embed` is `burn`. *Advanced.* |
| `position` | `--position` | choice | `bottom` | One of: `bottom`, `top`, `middle`. Only used when `embed` is `burn`. |
| `margin` | `--margin` | integer 0–500 | `20` | Only used when `embed` is `burn`. *Advanced.* |
| `quality` | `--quality` | choice | `medium` | Encoding quality used when the video must be re-encoded. One of: `high` (High (larger file)), `medium` (Balanced), `low` (Low (smaller file)). *Advanced.* |

## Text to Speech

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-model">local model</span><span>Piper TTS</span><span>model: piper</span></div>

Turn text into natural-sounding speech offline with Piper neural voices; save as WAV, MP3, Ogg, Opus, FLAC or M4A.

```sh
dogubako speech tts <text> [options]
```

Id `speech.tts` · MCP `speech_tts` · Output: files · Timeout 30 min

Also found by: tts, read aloud, voice, narration, speech synthesis, piper, audiobook

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` *(required)* | positional | text (multi-line) |  |  |
| `voice` | `--voice` | choice | `auto` | One of: `auto` (First installed voice), `piper-en_US-lessac-medium` (Piper voice: English (US) Lessac, medium), `piper-en_GB-alan-medium` (Piper voice: English (UK) Alan, medium), `piper-de_DE-thorsten-medium` (Piper voice: German Thorsten, medium). |
| `speed` | `--speed` | number 0.25–4 | `1` |  |
| `sentence_pause` | `--sentence-pause` | number 0–5 | `0.2` | Pause between sentences (s). *Advanced.* |
| `speaker` | `--speaker` | integer 0–1000 |  | Speaker id for multi-speaker voices. *Advanced.* |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `wav` | One of: `wav`, `mp3`, `ogg` (Ogg Vorbis), `opus`, `flac`, `m4a` (AAC (M4A)). |

## Voice Activity Detection

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>progress</span></div>

Find where people are speaking in audio or video using the WebRTC voice activity detector; returns speech segments and can export JSON, CSV, SRT or Audacity labels.

```sh
dogubako speech vad <file> [options]
```

Id `speech.vad` · MCP `speech_vad` · Output: structured data · Timeout 240 min

Also found by: vad, speech detection, voice detection, speech segments, webrtc, talking, non-speech

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | file |  | Audio file. Accepts audio/\*, video/\*, .mp3 .m4a .aac .wav .flac .ogg +24 more. |
| `aggressiveness` | `--aggressiveness` | integer 0–3 | `2` | 0 = keep more audio as speech, 3 = strictest filtering of non-speech. |
| `min_speech_ms` | `--min-speech-ms` | integer 0–10000 | `250` | Minimum speech (ms). *Advanced.* |
| `min_silence_ms` | `--min-silence-ms` | integer 0–10000 | `300` | Shorter pauses are merged into the surrounding speech. *Advanced.* |
| `padding_ms` | `--padding-ms` | integer 0–5000 | `200` | Extra audio kept around each speech segment. *Advanced.* |
| `frame_ms` | `--frame-ms` | choice | `30` | Analysis frame length (ms). One of: `10`, `20`, `30`. *Advanced.* |
| `export` | `--export` | choice | `none` | One of: `none`, `json`, `csv`, `srt` (SRT (one cue per segment)), `audacity` (Audacity labels). |

## Split at Pauses

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>progress</span></div>

Split long recordings into chunks no longer than a maximum length, cutting in pauses between speech (found by VAD) — ideal before transcription or upload limits.
